packMeta.name: PawRoute (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey dog walking & pet care operations hub: daily walk run-sheet with 1-click owner updates, temperament & medical pet profiles, home access client cards, walkers roster, and incidents log. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
